title: Fix a deep equality check
prompt: deepEqual(a, b) in equal.js returns true for some values that differ. Make it correct for primitives, plain objects, arrays and Dates: NaN equals NaN; an array never equals a plain object; objects are equal only with the same own enumerable keys (a key set to undefined is not the same as a missing key) and equal values; Dates are equal when they hold the same time, and a Date never equals a non-Date. Nested values are compared the same way. Do not change test.js.
